task: grade spasticity (KV>=0.050 vs KV<=0.025) across MIXED lesions of every weakness depth, under the PREREG_videoknee_r422 noise model
VERDICT: spasticity grading across mixed lesions holds at 0.829 accuracy at sigma 2 deg and 0.770 at sigma 5 deg under 30 fps, 20 deg yaw and +/-1 frame event error

READING_r435.the_number_that_matters: accuracy at ZERO noise is 0.8404. That is the ceiling imposed by mixing weakness depths, before any camera is involved.

noise_costs_little.reading: from a clean signal to sigma 2 deg -- the typical markerless error -- accuracy falls only 0.84 to 0.83. Even at an unreasonable sigma 10 it is 0.69. VIDEO NOISE IS NOT THE LIMITING FACTOR.

the_mixture_costs_a_lot.cost: about 14 percentage points, and it is present at zero noise. VIDEOKNEE_r422 measured 0.97 on pure spastic versus pure weak; the same task across mixed lesions of every weakness depth is 0.83.

READING_r435.disjointness_is_zero_everywhere: even with no noise at all the two groups overlap, because spanning four weakness depths widens each group. Disjointness was never the right statistic for a clinical claim -- see VIDEOKNEE_r422's own reading -- and here it is zero by construction.
READING_r435.WHAT_THIS_MEANS_FOR_THE_PAPER: the limitation is biological, not technical. Buying a better camera or a better pose estimator does not recover the 14 points; they are lost to the fact that dorsiflexor weakness moves the same endpoint in the opposite direction. That is a statement about the endpoint, and it points at the fix: a second variable that responds to weakness but not to spasticity would restore the separation. This corpus has not found one, and SCREEN_ALL_r433 plus STATIONARITY_r434 are the record of looking.
READING_r435.the_defensible_clinical_sentence: 'across simulated lesions spanning four dorsiflexor weakness depths, knee angle at heel strike graded plantarflexor spastic gain at 83% accuracy under 30 fps sagittal video with 20 degrees of camera yaw, one frame of event error and 2 degrees of per-frame keypoint noise. Accuracy without any noise was 84%, so the residual error is attributable to the lesion mixture rather than to the measurement.'

UNREGISTERED_OR_SUPERSEDED_LABEL_r438: EXPLORATORY. No registration exists. Its binary task (KV>=0.050 vs <=0.025) and its threshold were both chosen after the data were seen, and FLOOR_CORRECTION_r436 found the threshold was in-sample -- the LOO figures there supersede the numbers in this file. May not be quoted beside a registered result without this label.
